pmd - escape explorer (MarkStoreEscaping=false (patch 0004, roots mode))

top reason sets drawn individually, rest aggregated
follow calls out of the method (adds callee nodes)
trace contributors: highlight everything whose escaping feeds the hovered object
CONTAINMENT — a.f = b
FIELD_LOAD — a = b.f
ARGUMENT — passed to a callee
RETURN — returned
Both solid kinds come from the same Fields: map — Stava does not distinguish them. The split is inferred here from the target's object type. Click any edge for detail.
Colour = equi-escape set (definition S). Nothing else is coloured.
dashed outline = parameter / return node, not an allocation
red outline = library boundary (callee outside the filter)
red hatched outline = the set contains a reason that is not a known program cause: a surrender (Stava gave up) or an unresolved successor chain (SUCCESSOR_*)
grey = the aggregated "other" square; its member count is shown and is never dropped
Square AREA is proportional to member count. Big number = reasons in the set, small number = objects.
